clue.text: Unavailing Kipling poem describing the French

indicators.note: describing in its old sense of drawing a line around, so the poem's letters surround the French article

parts.note: Boots is a Rudyard Kipling poem about marching soldiers
les is the French plural word for 'the'

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses a Kipling poem about the French as useless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' is used in its old geometric sense of drawing round, so it signals a container, not a description.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean to no avail: an archaic synonym for futile or useless.

clue.text: Ishmael, perhaps not in form

parts.note: out is the opposite of in
a cast is a form or mould

explanation.surface: A man named Ishmael is perhaps out of shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Ishmael, son of Abraham, was driven into the wilderness, the type of the exile or pariah.

clue.text: Garment at fault for Katharina possibly

indicators.note: at fault means in error, so the letters of the fodder are wrongly arranged

explanation.surface: A dress is to blame, perhaps, for an actress playing Katharina.
explanation.walkthrough: Katharina is the shrew of Shakespeare's The Taming of the Shrew.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's shrew is the classic scolding, violent-tempered woman.

clue.text: Starts to earn money with scheme providing commission

indicators.note: starts to picks the opening letter of each of the next two words

parts.note: a ploy is a scheme or stratagem

explanation.surface: A newcomer's earnings begin with a plan that pays commission.
explanation.definitionFit: To commission someone is to engage or hire them for a job.

clue.text: Uninterrupted run from pack supported by hooker, say

indicators.note: in a down answer the supported piece sits on top, above the hooker piece

parts.note: a straight is a run of consecutive cards in poker
a hooker is a rugby forward, in the front row of the scrum

explanation.surface: A rugby player makes an unbroken run from the scrum, backed up by the hooker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pack' and 'hooker' both suggest the rugby scrum, but the run is a card sequence from the pack of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Direct and continuous, without detours or breaks.

clue.text: Crown servant' entertaining journalist is rebuffed

indicators.note: rebuffed means pushed back, so the whole assembled servant-and-journalist string is read backwards
a host entertaining a guest holds them within, so the servant's letters go around the journalist's

parts.note: a maid is a female servant
ED is the usual crossword abbreviation for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A royal servant who has a reporter round finds herself snubbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entertaining' gives MEDAID, and 'is rebuffed' turns that whole string round, not just the servant.
explanation.definitionFit: A jewelled headband worn as a mark of royalty is a kind of crown.

clue.text: Devote materials out of business to make a bird sanctuary

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: CO, short for company, is a business

explanation.surface: Raw materials from a closed-down firm are dedicated to building a bird reserve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'materials' marks DEVOTE as the raw stuff; 'out' scrambles it with CO.
explanation.definitionFit: A structure where doves and pigeons roost and are kept safe.

clue.text: State paper from ambassador perhaps incomplete

indicators.note: incomplete means the last letter of the envoy word is missing

parts.note: an ambassador is an example of a diplomat

explanation.surface: An official document from an envoy is unfinished.
explanation.definitionFit: A document issued by an authority conferring an honour or qualification.

clue.text: In France she serves in motorway refreshment area

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI in crosswords
a dinette is a small dining area

explanation.surface: A French waitress works at a service station on the motorway.
explanation.definitionFit: A young Parisian shop girl or seamstress, a French word.

clue.text: Before the bench after prison ferment

indicators.note: after places the prison word first, with the court phrase following it in the answer

parts.note: stir is slang for prison
to be up before the bench is to appear in court before the magistrates

explanation.surface: A man in court after a spell in jail stirs up trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to ferment trouble is to agitate or provoke it.

clue.text: Improvise in instrumental part with revised arrangement

indicators.note: in places the improvising word inside the instrument word

parts.note: a reed is the vibrating part of a clarinet or oboe
to vamp is to improvise a simple accompaniment

explanation.surface: A musician improvises within an instrumental section in a reworked arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reworked and given a fresh arrangement has been renovated or overhauled.

clue.text: A dandy dish

definitions.meaning: an eighteenth-century fop who affected continental fashions
a pasta made in tubes, served as a dish

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a Georgian fop (as in Yankee Doodle) and a tube pasta.

clue.text: Firms in association acting to provide protective cover

parts.note: two firms, each CO, the abbreviation for company
on means acting, as an actor on stage

explanation.surface: Associated companies perform to provide insurance cover.
explanation.definitionFit: A silky case spun by a larva shields it, so it is a protective covering.

clue.text: Charts needed for a sailor's return

indicators.note: return means go back, so the sailor word is read in reverse

parts.note: an old salt is an experienced sailor; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: Maps are required for a seaman's homeward voyage.
explanation.definitionFit: A bound book of maps and charts is called by this name.

clue.text: The sort of paintings a thief takes

definitions.meaning: to take away or steal, as a thief does

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both non-figurative art and a verb for stealing.

clue.text: Lure not spotted at first got the fish

indicators.note: at first moves the unspotted word to the front, ahead of the lure

parts.note: white suggests unspotted, pure and without blemish
bait is a lure for fish

explanation.surface: An angler's lure went unseen at first but still caught the fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not spotted' looks like 'unseen' but means spotless; 'at first' sends that piece to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny young herring and sprats, eaten fried whole, go by this collective name.

clue.text: Severe criticism of reproduction sideboard

indicators.note: a reproduction copies the original in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An antique dealer is slated for selling a fake sideboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A fierce verbal attack, from the simultaneous firing of a warship's guns.

clue.text: Exercise in musical group spoken simultaneously

indicators.note: in puts the exercise word inside the musical group word

parts.note: a chord is a group of notes sounded together
to exercise is to use

explanation.surface: A vocal exercise in a choir has everyone speaking at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'musical group' suggests a band but is a group of notes, CHORD.
explanation.definitionFit: Said in unison by several people at once.

clue.text: Whip no longer operative, so cease to attend

parts.note: a switch is a thin flexible cane used as a whip
off means not working or turned off

explanation.surface: A rider's crop is out of action, so the rider stops paying attention.
explanation.walkthrough: The '8' in the held clue is a stray mark beside the printed text; the scan has no number.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop paying attention and let one's mind drift is an idiomatic phrasal verb.

clue.text: Develop passion for current girl friend

parts.note: in means current or fashionable
an old flame is a sweetheart

explanation.surface: A man falls for a fashionable girlfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: To arouse strong feeling, kindling ardour or anger.

clue.text: Pair refusing to have learner in car

indicators.note: refusing to have the learner means that letter is dropped from the pair word

parts.note: a couple is a pair
L is for learner, from the L-plate on a learner driver's car

explanation.surface: A couple will not let a learner driver into their car.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-door closed sports saloon is a style of car with this name.

clue.text: Soft toy making baby talk

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for soft
a rattle is a baby's toy

explanation.surface: A soft toy gets an infant babbling.
explanation.definitionFit: Childish chatter, foolish or artless talk.

clue.text: Drift coming in from offshore

definitions.meaning: the drift of a remark is its meaning or gist
goods brought into the country from abroad

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the gist of something and goods bought from abroad.

clue.text: A high overhead for a traveller on water

definitions.meaning: a sloping roof beam, high above one's head
one who travels on a raft

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a roof beam and, playfully, one who floats downriver on a raft.

clue.text: Intended to repair vehicles left by engineers

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
media are vehicles or channels of communication

explanation.surface: Engineers drop off cars that they intend to fix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vehicles' suggests cars but means channels of communication, MEDIA; 'by' sets the engineers next to them.
explanation.definitionFit: Corrective measures meant to put something right are described with this adjective.

clue.text: Clean doctrine with a special appeal

parts.note: to char is to do cleaning work, as a charwoman
an ism is a doctrine or system of belief

explanation.surface: A purifying creed carries an unusual attraction.
explanation.definitionFit: Magnetic personal allure that inspires devotion is this quality.

clue.text: Number right to abandon old buccaneer

indicators.note: the right letter abandons, leaving the buccaneer word without it

parts.note: a buccaneer is a pirate

explanation.surface: A figure entitled to leave an old pirate in the lurch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' is not a figure but something that numbs, a drug.
explanation.definitionFit: A narcotic dulls feeling, so it is something that numbs.

clue.text: Cooked food in haste — we dined early

indicators.note: in says the answer lies within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Food was cooked in a rush because we were eating early.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'haSTE WE Dined'.
explanation.definitionFit: Simmered slowly in liquid is one way of being cooked.

clue.text: Spot found near shady tree by lake bird

parts.note: a dot is a spot

indicators.note: shady means dubious or crooked, so the tree's letters are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: A spot near a shaded tree by the water where a bird was seen.
explanation.definitionFit: A plover of moors and mountains is one particular species of bird.
